I’m afraid I don’t have the ability to automatically add events to your personal calendars or send you notifications from here. But it’s easy to put a quick reminder into most devices’ native apps (or even a simple text file). Here’s a short guide: | Platform | How to Add a Reminder | |----------|-----------------------| | **iPhone / iPad** | • Open *Calendar* → tap “+” → choose “Event”.
• Set title (“Netflix Subscription Renewal”), start time (March 27), and toggle “Add Alert” to get a notification before the day. | | **Android Phone** | • Open *Google Calendar* → tap “Create” → select “Event”.
• Fill out details and under “Notifications”, pick when you’d like to be reminded. | | **Windows PC** | • Use Microsoft Outlook or the built‑in *Alarms & Clock* app.
• In Outlook, click “New Appointment”; fill in subject and date/time, then set a reminder popup. | | **Mac** | • Launch *Calendar*, double‑click March 27, type “Netflix Subscription Renewal.”
• Click “Alert” dropdown to decide when you’ll receive a pop‑up. | | **Web Browser** | • Create a new event in Google Calendar via web ().
• Or simply write a note in a document titled “Reminders – March 27” and save it somewhere visible. | If you prefer a more automated approach, many task‑management services such as Todoist, Notion, or Trello let you set due dates and push email/SMS alerts—just paste the same information there. Let me know which method works best for you, and I can walk through the exact steps!
